halfThisLaneRepaired.defect: a synthesized hairline square stamped at every unticked check box, inside the box the Judicial Council's form prints
halfThisLaneRepaired.mechanismVerifiedNotAssumed: The FIX118 mechanism was checked against this family's own bytes rather than carried over. All 18 CR-180 check-box widgets declare /AP /N holding only their on state (/1, /2 or /3) and no /Off entry, and all 18 sit at /AS /Off, so PDFCheckBox.needsAppearancesUpdate() is true on every one and form.updateFieldAppearances() replaces each with pdf-lib's default provider. The delivered bytes carry exactly 18 flattened Form XObjects that stroke a closed four-segment path and draw no glyph ('0 0 0 RG 0 w [] 0 d ... 0 0 m 0 9 l 9 9 l 9 0 l h S'); the pinned source derivative carries none. 18 widgets, 18 squares, one to one.
halfThisLaneRepaired.itIsIntroducedNotPreserved: The form draws its own box in page content at a different place and a different size. CR-180 page 1 line 2 strokes '50.873 270.046 18 9 re S' while the widget /Rect there is x=55.74 y=270.66 w=9 h=9, so pdf-lib's square lands inset and offset inside the box the issuer prints. That is the doubled outline.
halfThisLaneRepaired.repair: suppressSynthesizedAppearances, an option the shared finalizer already implements and documents, set on this family's config only. It installs the empty /Off appearance the form omits, so needsAppearancesUpdate() is false and pdf-lib regenerates nothing.
halfThisLaneRepaired.noOwedDeliveryShrunk: This family's production-field-map.json declares selections: 0 and reports/actual-writes.json contains no isSelectionControl write, so the route ticks no CR-180 check box. Every one of the 18 widgets is unticked, and removing pdf-lib's synthesized /Off square removes no mark. No participant fact, signature, election or issuer statement was removed.
